title: Ultralytics YOLO Evolution: An Overview of YOLO27, YOLO26, YOLO11, YOLOv8, and YOLOv5 Object Detectors for Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2510.09653v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive overview of the Ultralytics YOLO family, emphasizing architectural evolution, benchmarking, deployment, and emerging directions from YOLOv5 through YOLO27. The review begins with YOLO27 (or YOLOv27), which introduces a scale-adaptive dual-architecture strategy: compact YOLO27n/s detectors employ streamlined CNNs with dual-scale prediction, strengthened high-resolution features, foreground-alignment supervision, and conventional or NMS-free inference, whereas YOLO27m/l adopt query-based transformer decoding for native NMS-free detection. YOLO27l further incorporates an UltraViT backbone with deep-stage self-attention for global-context modeling. Preliminary COCO results span 42.3-60.4 mAP at 640-pixel resolution and 0.62-2.32 ms TensorRT 11 FP16 latency, with YOLO27l reaching 61.2 mAP at 800 pixels. translated_title: Ultralytics YOLO的演进：面向计算机视觉与模式识别的YOLO27、YOLO26、YOLO11、YOLOv8和YOLOv5目标检测器综述
translated_abstract: 本文对Ultralytics YOLO系列进行了全面综述，重点介绍了从YOLOv5到YOLO27的架构演进、基准测试、部署方式及新兴发展方向。综述首先从YOLO27（或称YOLOv27）开始，该版本引入了尺度自适应的双架构策略：轻量级的YOLO27n/s检测器采用精简的CNN结构，具备双尺度预测、强化高分辨率特征、前景对齐监督以及常规或无NMS推理；而YOLO27m/l则采用基于查询的Transformer解码，实现原生的无NMS检测。YOLO27l进一步集成了带有深层阶段自注意力的UltraViT骨干网络，用于全局上下文建模。初步COCO结果显示，在640像素分辨率下mAP范围为42.3-60.4，TensorRT 11 FP16延迟为0.62-2.32毫秒，其中YOLO27l在800像素下达到61.2 mAP。随后综述追溯了YOLO26的演进，包括移除DFL、渐进式损失平衡等内容。
tldr: 本文系统综述了Ultralytics YOLO系列目标检测器从YOLOv5到YOLO27的架构演进，重点介绍了YOLO27的尺度自适应双架构设计及其在检测精度和推理速度上的显著提升。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a comprehensive overview of the architectural evolution of the Ultralytics YOLO detector family from YOLOv5 to YOLO27, highlighting YOLO27's scale-adaptive dual-architecture strategy and its significant improvements in detection accuracy and inference speed.
